title: Doesn’t work well at all
content: I have to open the app for auto track to begin and even then it only picks up part of the drive I’ve found Mile IQ is a much better tracking app! And have  no way to cancel my subscription except to send feedback and get no response.
author: App robbed

title: Not great
content: Auto tracking has yet to work for me. Got this app so I wouldn’t have to remember to track my mileage every time I got in my car. Still have to do it manually. Waste of money, should have gone with another app.
author: Rtm73

title: Deleted tracks
content: Im not sure how they have a 4.4 review because all of the ones im seeing are 1 star. It does the job - usually but there have been MANY instances where I will press go, close the app, drive around and when I reopen it the app has restarted deleting my mileage. As someone who drives a lot for work this is a huge tax write off, on top of already having to pay for this app. You can add a personal trip but there’s no way to set it as business so the filtering gets all thrown off
author: P-rios

title: Not impressed
content: It should have automatic start so I don’t have to remember every time I get in the car. It also stops recording without prompting and disappears. Very frustrating and not trustworthy.
author: Colorblind sorta

title: Data gone
content: Not only do you have to tell it you are starting a trip but it just randomly deleted my entire milage log
author: kismycanthavsamename

title: Auto Tracking
content: I have the feature of auto tracking on for my trips, but it only activates and tracks them about 1/4 of the time
author: T swizzle 1

title: Trips Keep Getting Lost
content: I purchased this app and I’m very disappointed. It constantly crashes and restarts itself. The most frustrating part is when I’ve driven a couple hundred miles only to find out the trip was lost and nothing was recorded. In just two weeks of using the app, this problem has happened five times.
author: Tom Lamo

title: Doesn’t auto track trips
content: I accidentally downloaded this app when I wanted mileiq. There’s no way I’m going to remember to open the app every time I take a trip.
author: Johnniebojangles

title: Mile
content: I keep having trouble with the app, turning itself off and not giving me credit for the miles
author: KMS13*

title: Rip off app
content: This app is a rip off! It will not record any long trips for work. I have over 3,000 miles and it says I have under 1,000 I want my money back!
author: Mileage IQ is trash

title: App cuts out
content: I’ve had multiple trips that I started , but when I get where I’m going, the app is no longer activated and I can’t manually add a trip. I still have to keep a log so at the end of the month I can add the trips it failed to capture.
author: Stefsbox

title: No response
content: Can’t get any assistance from the developer.  App doesn’t work as advertised.  Has dropped trips after I started them, no prompts to ask if the trip is done or save the progress.
author: Matt Sowa

title: False advertisement
content:
I paid $70 for this app and I have to turn it on and leave the screen up the entire time I am driving? I drive about 30 hours a week, I can’t keep my app open the entire drive. I need to use my GPS, make phone calls, etc.
I emailed support to ask if there is something wrong because it states that it starts automaticallyHave not heard back
author: SarahLc2210
